definitions.explanation: The part of a road designated for vehicles, as opposed to sidewalks for pedestrians.

examples.japanese: {車道|しゃどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It's dangerous to walk on the roadway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{車道|しゃどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}ら→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Bicycles must ride on the roadway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{車道|しゃどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}した→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧。
examples.english: A child ran out onto the roadway.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{車道|しゃどう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれて→分かれる：01113_wakareru⟧⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Here the roadway and sidewalk are not separated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{車道|しゃどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Part of the roadway is closed due to construction.

notes:
{車道|しゃどう} combines ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle) + ⟦{道|どう}→道：noentry⟧ (road/way).

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧ (sidewalk) - antonym
- ⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧ (lane)
- ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧ (road)
- ⟦{国道|こくどう}→国道：noentry⟧ (national highway)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {車道|しゃどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to drive on the roadway)
- {車道|しゃどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to go onto the roadway)
- {車道|しゃどう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧ (roadway and sidewalk)

USAGE NOTES:
- In Japan, bicycles are legally required to use {車道|しゃどう} in most cases
- Important vocabulary for traffic safety and driving
